parameters.jsCode:
const m = $('Extract External Attendees').first().json;
const c = $('Classify Company Type').first().json;
const domains = (m.externalEmails || []).map(e => (String(e).split('@')[1] || '')).filter(Boolean);
const system = [
  'You classify one business meeting into exactly one category, using the external participants and the meeting content.',
  'Categories:',
  '- SALES: Novagentica is the SELLER; the external party is a customer or prospect evaluating or buying Novagentica AI products or services.',
  '- VENDOR: the external party is SELLING TO Novagentica - a supplier, tool, SaaS, contractor, or service provider pitching or servicing something Novagentica buys.',
  '- PARTNER: a channel, referral, reseller, alliance, integration, or co-delivery partner; mutual go-to-market or joint delivery.',
  '- INVESTOR: a VC, angel, LP, or investor-relations conversation (fundraising, diligence, investor updates).',
  '- OTHER: recruiting/interview, press/analyst, networking, or genuinely unclear.',
  'Decision rule: work out who is selling to whom. If the EXTERNAL party is pitching or selling something Novagentica would BUY (or Novagentica is reviewing their proposal or pricing), it is VENDOR. If Novagentica is selling ITS OWN AI services to the external party, it is SALES.',
  'Treat the CRM company type as a strong hint but override it when the meeting content clearly indicates a different category.',
  'Decide decisively on exactly one category. Respond with ONLY a minified JSON object and nothing else, no markdown. Keep reasoning to at most 12 words. Format: {"category":"SALES|VENDOR|PARTNER|INVESTOR|OTHER","confidence":0.0-1.0,"reasoning":"<=12 words"}.'
].join('\n');
const userContent = [
  'MEETING TITLE: ' + (m.meetingTitle || '(none)'),
  'FIREFLIES MEETING TYPE: ' + (m.meetingType || 'unknown'),
  'EXTERNAL ATTENDEE EMAILS: ' + ((m.externalEmails || []).join(', ') || '(none)'),
  'EXTERNAL DOMAINS: ' + (domains.join(', ') || '(none)'),
  'CRM COMPANY: ' + (c.companyName || '(not found in CRM)'),
  'CRM COMPANY TYPE (hint, may be missing/wrong): ' + (c.companyType || '(none)'),
  'CRM INDUSTRY: ' + (c.companyIndustry || '(none)'),
  'OVERVIEW: ' + String(m.lastCallSummary || '').slice(0, 1500),
  'GIST: ' + (m.gist || ''),
  'TOPICS: ' + (Array.isArray(m.topicsDiscussed) ? m.topicsDiscussed.join('; ') : (m.topicsDiscussed || ''))
].join('\n');
return [{ json: { system, userContent } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const p = $('Parse Classification').first().json; const m = $('Extract External Attendees').first().json; const trunc = (s, n) => s && s.length > n ? s.slice(0, n-1) + '…' : (s || ''); const props = { 'Title': { 'title': [{ 'text': { 'content': (p.categoryEmoji || '📝') + ' ' + (m.meetingTitle || '(untitled)') } }] }, 'Date': { 'date': { 'start': m.meetingDate } }, 'Type': { 'select': { 'name': p.notionType || 'Other' } }, 'Fireflies ID': { 'rich_text': [{ 'text': { 'content': String(p.meetingId || m.meetingId || '') } }] } }; if (p.companyId) props['Companies'] = { 'relation': [{ 'id': p.companyId }] }; if (p.contactId) props['Contacts'] = { 'relation': [{ 'id': p.contactId }] }; const children = [ { 'object':'block','type':'callout','callout':{ 'rich_text':[{ 'type':'text','text':{ 'content': 'Classified as ' + (p.category||'OTHER') + ' (confidence ' + Math.round((p.confidence||0)*100) + '%). ' + (p.reasoning||'') } }], 'icon': { 'emoji': (p.categoryEmoji||'📝') }, 'color': (p.needsReview ? 'yellow_background' : 'gray_background') } }, { 'object':'block','type':'paragraph','paragraph':{ 'rich_text':[{ 'type':'text','text':{ 'content': trunc(m.lastCallSummary, 1900) } }] } } ]; if (m.transcriptUrl) { children.push({ 'object':'block','type':'paragraph','paragraph':{ 'rich_text':[{ 'type':'text','text':{ 'content': 'Transcript', 'link': { 'url': m.transcriptUrl } } }] } }); } return { 'parent': { 'database_id': 'be0a73a826854e5c827e15ba07dd315c' }, 'properties': props, 'children': children }; })() }}
